questions.questionText: X, Y and Z are partners in a firm. Due to differences amongst the partners, there is deadlock in the management. X applies to the court for the dissolution of the firm. Will he succeed?

options.text: Yes, on just and equitable ground
No, because it is not a valid ground for dissolution
No, it will require consent of all the partners
Yes, if the Registrar of Firm agrees.

questions.explanation: Correct answer according to official ICAI Study Material for The Indian Partnership Act: Registration and Dissolution is (A).

questions.questionText: Mr. A, partner of ABC Associates give notice in writing to all other partners i.e. Mr. B and Mr. C of his intention to dissolve the firm on 01.09.2020. Such notice was dated 30.08.2020. In the given case, the firm stands dissolved with effect from______________.

options.text: Neither 30.08.2020 nor 01.09.2020 but as per the date mentioned in partnership deed as last date of existence of the firm.
Either 30.08.2020 or 01.09.2020 as mutually agreed by all three partners.

questions.explanation: Correct answer according to official ICAI Study Material for The Indian Partnership Act: Registration and Dissolution is (B).
